description: Seznam javno dostopnih WIFI točk v občini Bistrica ob Sotli is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA BISTRICA OB SOTLI. The database contains location information The following data are included: point name, location coordinate (x, y), speed (Mbit/100), provider. Coverage: OBČINA BISTRICA OB SOTLI. The portal shows the English title as "List of publicly accessible WIFI points in the municipality of Bistrica ob Sotli" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA BISTRICA OB SOTLI. Its keywords include WiFi točke. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
